question: What powers and status does the practitioner of this mantra attain?
premises: The practitioner becomes lord of the eight siddhis beginning with aṇimā.
The practitioner becomes like Indra directly on earth.
inference: Mastery of this mantra grants lordship over the eight siddhis and an Indra-like status on earth.
plain_english: One becomes the lord of the eight siddhis beginning with aṇimā and is directly like Indra on earth.
